summary: Iovance Biotherapeutics filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on November 5, 2026, disclosing an updated corporate presentation (Exhibit 99.1) for use at healthcare conferences and with analysts and stockholders. No transaction, stake, price, premium, or board recommendation is disclosed. The filing notes Frederick G. Vogt as Interim CEO, President and General Counsel, but no abrupt departure is described in the excerpt. Structural content is a standard forward-looking-statements disclaimer. No deal terms, capital-returns action, or special-situation mechanic is present; watch only for any later strategic update signaled in the deck.
